detail.longDescription: OpenAI has released 722 mathematical papers from an unreleased AI model, covering 372 open problems including the Riemann hypothesis and Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture - each worth 1 million USD in prize money. The academic community has been left in shock, with some describing it as a "mathocalypse". Concerns remain over whether the claimed solutions are correct. https:// theconversation.com/is-this-th e-mathocalypse-why-openais-latest-results-dump-has-left-mathematicians-in-shock-293837 # AIresearch # AI # GenAI # Math
